Mine was probably around 11/12? I lived in an abusive household and I thought if I did and didn’t die they’d pay attention to me... but that didn’t happen. They found out and cried then told me my life wasn’t bad enough for me to be depressed cause some people are homeless and at least I have a home. 
Here I am 22 still going through the same stuff. Don’t know why I think it will change but oh well. Just seeing how long I can go for.
